crew_permission_allow_bypass_hint: Off hides Bypass, moves every crewmate in Bypass back to Ask, and engines that cannot ask will refuse tasks.
crew_permission_answered_task: Allowed for this task by you · {time}
crew_permission_applies_next: Applies from the next tool call.
crew_permission_comment_placeholder: Why, or what to do instead
crew_permission_default_hint: The permission mode a crewmate starts in. Engines that cannot ask always start in Bypass.
crew_permission_fixed_reason: Fixed: this engine has no approval channel.
crew_permission_hint_bypass: Runs every tool call without asking, except protected files and tasks from GitHub or a webhook.
crew_permission_hint_edits: Edits files in its work tree without asking; asks before anything else.
crew_permission_rail_no_auto: Held even in Bypass: this task came from GitHub or a webhook.
crew_permission_rail_protected_path: Held even in Bypass: it touches a protected file or folder.
crew_permission_settings_mode_hint: What this crewmate may do without asking you. You can also switch it from the message box.
